title: Meghalaya & Assam: A First-Timer’s Guide to Northeast India
subtitle: Northeast India is a mystical expanse of untouched natural wonders, indigenous tribal cultures, and dramatic landscapes.

contentSections.heading: Top Experiences
contentSections.content: Cherrapunji is one of the wettest places on Earth, with soaring waterfalls like Nohkalikai Falls. In Dawki, boats appear to float in mid-air over the crystal-clear Umngot River.

contentSections.heading: Travel Tips
bulletPoints: Wear sturdy non-slip trekking shoes for the root bridge walks in Meghalaya.
Visitors to Arunachal Pradesh or certain Sikkim border areas require an Inner Line Permit (ILP).
